sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: At its core, Coffy's gameplay revolves around serving six coffees within a set time limit. The game features a straightforward control system, allowing players to use mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate and serve the coffees. Your goal is to guide a coffee cup to its corresponding mug, while avoiding obstacles and hazards that will slow you down or hinder your progress. As you progress through the game, the speed and difficulty level will increase, requiring you to react quickly and make precise decisions to succeed. Coffy's simple yet challenging gameplay makes it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.
